title: Speeding up a Markov environment can increase mean workload: a counterexample to the universal form of Ross's second conjecture
description: Explicit finite-state Markov-modulated Poisson arrival processes, and a random-phase periodic one, for which speeding up the environment strictly increases mean stationary workload in a single-server queue with unit deterministic service. This answers the universal-validity question in Problem 1 of Leskelä (2022) in the negative.
